Product Manager - Lending & Credit
CRED
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (On-site)

About the Role:
Own digital lending products, underwriting funnels, and repayment UX for high-net-worth users.

Responsibilities:
• Define product strategy, user stories, and PRDs for credit line extensions.
• Coordinate with bank partners, risk models, and engineering.
• Track funnel drop-offs, conversion rates, and loan default indicators with SQL.

Requirements:
• 2 to 4 years of experience in fintech or consumer product management.
• Must be based in Mumbai office (on-site role).
• B.Tech or equivalent degree.
